does: Rolls a formula for a roller against a difficulty on the stream named by its id: finds the stream, marks the manager changed, and, when weighted rolls are on and the stream's type is weighted, first lets the weighted decision force the outcome; otherwise rolls with boosts and moves the debts.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll stream counts: both d20 draws of a fair melee attack return through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105B9ED of this function, called from RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x106CE8B); it scans the manager's streams (0x78 bytes each, the layout the rolls executor confirmed) for the one asked; callers include eoc::stats::AbilityCheck (code:eoc::stats::AbilityCheck) and the check against a DC at code:unplaced::RollSkillCheck
The count writes of a weapon attack's d20 pair return through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x105B9ED inside this function, called from the attack roll against armour class
The stream is looked up by the id at its +0x58; the manager's byte at +0x28 equal to 1 and a stream type other than 0, 6 and 7 lead to the weighted decision
EoCShared.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
